Summary/ Objective

Responsibleformanagingtheoverallproduct linestoensure materialavailabilityandsupportbusiness growth objectives. Manage product lifecycles for domestic and imported products, including new product registrations (NPR), commercialization readiness, production scale-up activities, raw material planning, and launch readiness for new products. Coordinate technical, purchasing, planning, operations, manufacturing, and sales activities necessary for successful commercialization and lifecycle management. This position combines classic product management responsibilities with significant supply chain, plant coordination, and operational execution responsibilities specific to Companys business model.

Works closely with Business Directors and Sales Managers to understand market opportunities, customer requirements, growth initiatives, competitive positioning, and strategic priorities. Provides market analysis on existing and emerging technologies and supports the development and execution of product strategies, product introductions, product rationalization decisions, and long-term portfolio plans that align with business objectives.

Responsible for maintaining budgeting, forecasting, demand planning, inventory management, and fulfillment processes to ensure reporting accuracy, product availability, and customer satisfaction. Supports Sales byensuring inventory levels are appropriate, manufacturing activities arealigned with demand requirements, and products are delivered in accordance with customer expectations.

Serves as the primary liaison between Sales Managers, Business Directors, Planning, Purchasing, Manufacturing, Logistics, and Customer Service to translate commercial objectives into operational execution. Works directly with Sales Managers and Business Directors to understand customer demand, sales opportunities, business priorities, forecast assumptions, and growth plans. Provides regular communication regarding demand trends, manufacturing status, product availability, inventory positions,forecastaccuracy, andsupplyconstraintswhilerecommendingactions necessarytosupport revenue growth and customer service objectives. The role works directly with the plant to align production capability, material availability, scheduling, quality and service priorities, inventory requirements, and customer commitments.

Supports business strategy by implementing tactical product line plans, coordinating supply chain resources,managing fulfillmentrisks,andensuringoperationalreadinessforbusiness growthinitiatives identified by Sales Managers and Business Directors.
